The most human part of this work is building trust with participants. A patient completes a trial and improves while the coordinated project eventually reaches approval. You are the person who keeps each link connected in the chain of medical progress.

The greatest satisfaction comes from watching a medicine reach patients. Trial data you coordinated can support a new-drug approval, while participants you cared for complete the study because of your follow-up. You contribute directly behind the scenes of medical progress.
